label: Nothing is moved except insofar as it is in…, from A being is being moved in a respect exactly…
meaning: Bridge (#401): Aristotle's definition of motion, *Physics* III.1, 201a10-11 (STMT-BEING-MOVED-IS-ACTUALIZATION-OF-POTENCY: a being is moved in a respect exactly when it is in potency to it and that potency, as potency, is being actualized), entails the prima via's premise (STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY): whatever is moved in a respect is in potency to it. Only the left-to-right half of the definition and its first conjunct are used. As for potency, ActPotencyDefinitionalAnalysesConservative shows the definition is no stronger than the premise; this bridge moves the premise's openness to the Aristotle reading and does not discharge it.
